arguments.summary: Bounded-source review did not retrieve a readable primary BIS or digital-regulatory policy document; therefore it cannot verify a current policy action, effective date, enforcement status, company-specific geographic exposure, or 21/63-session timing. The usable dated QQQ holding table shows indirect look-through to NVDA, MU and META, but not policy sensitivity or impact size.

claims.text: QQQ’s supplied holding table is dated 2026-09-12 (marked stale) and lists NVDA at 8.45%, MU at 4.85%, and META at 3.07%; it does not establish ANET exposure or any constituent’s policy sensitivity.

If a new semiconductor export-control action, enforcement action, or cross-border supply disruption were verified, the plausible channels would be restricted end-demand, licensing/compliance friction, or supply-chain disruption for MU/NVDA and potentially data-center networking demand for ANET. Magnitude and horizon are not established in the available evidence.

If a digital-regulatory, data-transfer, or cross-border advertising restriction were verified, the plausible META channel would be advertising targeting/measurement, product availability, compliance cost, or user/data access; QQQ could have indirect exposure through its dated META weight and other unquantified constituents. No impact or timing is established.

gaps.description: The designated BIS primary policy source was unavailable and no alternative readable primary policy document was supplied. Current semiconductor export-control action, scope, effective date, and enforcement status cannot be established.
No readable primary digital-regulatory or cross-border data/advertising policy source was available. Current action, enactment/enforcement status, and timing cannot be established.

Available materials do not quantify company-specific China/cross-border revenue, customer, product, manufacturing, supply-chain, data-transfer, or advertising exposure, nor QQQ’s full policy-sensitive holdings exposure.

assumptions: Transmission-channel statements are conditional scenarios, not assertions that a policy action occurred.
QQQ weights are dated 2026-09-12 and marked stale; they are fund look-through, not a personalized portfolio exposure.
arguments.counter_thesis: Absent a verified new restriction, enforcement event, or disclosed company exposure, policy headlines may have no material near-term operating effect; this bounded record cannot resolve that possibility.

review_conditions.description: Review upon publication of a readable primary semiconductor export-control or enforcement action and company disclosure identifying affected products, geography, or financial exposure.
Review upon a readable primary digital-regulatory/data-transfer/advertising action or Meta disclosure quantifying affected operations or revenue.

shared_exposures.mechanism: QQQ has dated indirect exposure to MU, META and NVDA through disclosed holdings; any verified company-level policy shock could transmit to the ETF, subject to holdings changes and unquantified other constituents.
shared_exposures.qualification: Holdings date is 2026-09-12 and marked stale; weights do not establish policy sensitivity, causality, or current composition.
